words.definition: vt. 减轻，缓和（痛苦、贫困、问题等）

examples.en: The subsidy failed to alleviate the burden of soaring housing costs.
examples.zh: 这项补贴未能减轻飙升的住房成本带来的负担。

examples.en: Emergency aid alleviated the food shortage in the drought-hit region.
examples.zh: 紧急援助缓解了旱灾地区的粮食短缺。

words.usage: 正式用语，宾语多为 pain、poverty、shortage 等抽象名词，比 relieve 书面；反义 aggravate（加重）。派生：alleviation n. 缓解

confusables.note: 提升；同词根 lev 勿混

collocations: alleviate traffic congestion 缓解交通拥堵
words.mnemonic: al（加强）+lev（轻，举）+iate → 把重物举轻 → 减轻

words.definition: vt. 诱导，引起；催产

examples.en: Prolonged stress can induce sleep disorders and weaken immunity.
examples.zh: 长期压力会诱发睡眠紊乱并削弱免疫力。

examples.en: No reward would induce the witness to reveal the informant's name.
examples.zh: 任何酬劳都无法诱使证人透露线人的姓名。

words.usage: 重点句型 induce sb to do sth（诱使某人做某事）；科技文表「引起（反应）」；医学 induce labor 催产。派生：inducement n. 诱因；induction n. 归纳
collocations: induce sb to do sth 诱使某人做某事
induce a heart attack 诱发心脏病
words.mnemonic: in（进入）+duce（引导）→ 引进来 → 引起、诱导

words.definition: n. 拒绝，拒不（做某事）；回绝（请求或提议）

examples.en: His outright refusal to cooperate brought the merger talks to a standstill.
examples.zh: 他断然拒绝合作，使并购谈判陷入僵局。

examples.en: The firm was fined over its repeated refusal to pay the minimum wage.
examples.zh: 该公司因屡次拒绝支付最低工资而被罚款。

words.usage: 常用 a refusal to do sth；常见搭配 meet with a refusal（遭到拒绝）、a flat refusal（断然拒绝）。源自动词 refuse。
collocations: a flat refusal 断然拒绝
refusal to comply 拒不服从
meet with a refusal 遭到拒绝
words.mnemonic: refuse（拒绝）+al → 名词：拒绝这一行为

words.definition: n. 伙伴，同事；家伙，人；adj. 同伴的，同类的

examples.en: Her fellow researchers refused to sign off on the disputed findings.
examples.zh: 她的研究同事拒绝为这些有争议的结论背书。

examples.en: He was regarded as a pleasant fellow by everyone in the department.
examples.zh: 系里的人都认为他是个讨人喜欢的家伙。

words.usage: 形容词用法常考：fellow students（同门）、fellow workers（同事），置于名词前；a fellow of the academy（学会会员）。派生：fellowship n. 友谊；奖学金

confusables.note: 跟随；ll 与元音易串位

collocations: a fellow of the academy 学会会员
words.mnemonic: fellow 与 follow 一字母之差：跟着走的 → 伙伴

words.definition: n. 垫子，席子；丛，团

examples.en: Visitors are asked to wipe their shoes on the mat before entering the lab.
examples.zh: 来客进实验室前须先在垫子上擦净鞋底。

examples.en: A thick mat of weeds covered the abandoned tennis court.
examples.zh: 厚厚一层杂草覆盖了废弃的网球场。

words.usage: 可数名词，复数 mats；doormat（门垫）喻逆来顺受的人；a mat of... 表成团的覆盖物。派生：matted adj. 缠结的

confusables.note: 网；m 与 n 形近

collocations: a mat of weeds 一丛杂草
words.mnemonic: m（门）+at（在）：在门口擦鞋的那块 → 垫子

words.definition: n. 发烧，发热；狂热，亢奋

examples.en: She was sent home from work with a high fever and a sore throat.
examples.zh: 她因高烧和喉咙痛被安排回家。

examples.en: The city was swept by a fever of speculation ahead of the election.
examples.zh: 大选前夕，全城笼罩在投机狂热之中。

words.usage: have 或 run a fever（发烧）；比喻义 a fever of excitement（一片狂热）阅读常考。派生：feverish adj. 发烧的；狂热的；feverishly adv.

confusables.note: 杠杆；首字母 f 与 l 串
严重的；fe- 与 se- 形近

collocations: a fever of excitement 一片狂热
words.mnemonic: f+ever：一「发」就烧个没完（ever）→ 发烧；狂热

words.definition: n. 难民；流亡者，避难者

examples.en: Hundreds of thousands of refugees fled across the border to escape the fighting.
examples.zh: 数十万难民为躲避战火越境而逃。

examples.en: The camp provides schooling and medical care for refugee children.
examples.zh: 该营地为难民儿童提供教育和医疗。

words.usage: 常与 from 连用（refugees from war）；与 migrant（移民）区分：refugee 强调被迫逃离。同根 refuge n. 避难所；asylum n. 庇护
words.mnemonic: refuge（避难）+ee（人）→ 寻求避难之人 → 难民

words.definition: adj. 视力的，视觉的；光学的

examples.en: The optical illusion exposes how easily the brain misreads visual cues.
examples.zh: 这一视错觉暴露出大脑多么容易误读视觉线索。

examples.en: Data travels through optical fibers as pulses of light.
examples.zh: 数据以光脉冲的形式通过光纤传输。

words.usage: optical 偏物理光学（optical fiber 光纤），visual 偏视觉感知，注意区分。派生：optics n. 光学；optician n. 眼镜商；optically adv.

confusables.note: 可选的；同 opt- 根易混

words.mnemonic: opt（眼、光）+ical → 与光和视觉有关的

words.definition: n. 比赛；对手；火柴；vt. 与…相配，比得上

examples.en: Few cities can match Shanghai in economic vitality.
examples.zh: 在经济活力方面，鲜有城市能与上海匹敌。

examples.en: The two sides will meet again in next month's qualifying match.
examples.zh: 双方将在下个月的预选赛中再次交手。

words.usage: 动词常考 match A with 或 against B；短语 no match for（敌不过）、match up to（符合期望）。派生：matching adj. 匹配的
collocations: a football match 一场足球赛
match supply with demand 使供需匹配
no match for sb 敌不过某人
words.mnemonic: 比赛找对手讲究「相配」，划根火柴照亮赛场

words.definition: adj. 女性的，有女性气质的；（语法）阴性的

examples.en: The brand redesigned its packaging to shed an overly feminine image.
examples.zh: 该品牌重新设计包装，以摆脱过于女性化的形象。

examples.en: In French, the word for house is feminine.
examples.zh: 在法语里，表示房子的名词是阴性的。

words.usage: feminine 指女性气质，female 仅表性别；语法术语阴性（feminine gender）与 masculine 相对。派生：femininity n. 女性气质；feminism n. 女权主义
words.mnemonic: femin（女性，同 female）+ine → 女性特有的

words.definition: n. 公民；市民，城镇居民

examples.en: Under the new constitution, every citizen is entitled to free primary education.
examples.zh: 根据新宪法，每位公民都有权享受免费初等教育。

examples.en: Senior citizens travel free on local buses at off-peak times.
examples.zh: 老年市民在非高峰时段可免费乘坐市内公交。

words.usage: a citizen of（…的公民）；senior citizen（老年人）固定说法。派生：citizenship n. 公民身份；civilian n. 平民（与军人相对），勿混

confusables.note: 平民；义近但指军人相对
文明；同根 civ- 易串

collocations: a citizen of the EU 欧盟公民
words.mnemonic: civ（城，同 city）+izen → 城邦中人 → 公民

words.definition: n. 市长；镇长（市镇首席行政官）

examples.en: The mayor unveiled a plan to halve the city's carbon emissions by 2035.
examples.zh: 市长公布了一项到 2035 年将全市碳排放减半的计划。

examples.en: Despite the scandal, voters re-elected the mayor for a third term.
examples.zh: 尽管丑闻缠身，选民仍让市长连任第三届。

words.usage: 女性市长亦称 mayor（mayoress 旧式）；相关词 mayoral adj. 市长的。英音与美音重音有差异，注意勿与 major（主要的）混读

confusables.note: 主要的；拼写仅差一字母

collocations: the mayor's office 市长办公室
elect a mayor 选举市长
words.mnemonic: may（可能）+or（人）→ 有可能主政一方的人 → 市长

words.definition: adj. 稠密的，密集的；（雾、烟）浓的；（人）迟钝的

examples.en: The valley shelters one of the densest forests in the northern hemisphere.
examples.zh: 这片山谷藏着北半球最茂密的森林之一。

examples.en: He was too dense to take the hint that the meeting was over.
examples.zh: 他迟钝得很，没听出会议已经结束的暗示。

words.usage: 副词 densely 常考：a densely populated city（人口稠密的城市）；名词 density n. 密度；condense v. 浓缩同根。be dense about sth（对…迟钝）

confusables.note: 紧张的；d 与 t 之差
感觉；d 与 s 形近

words.mnemonic: 全都挤成一团 → 稠密；脑子挤成一团 → 迟钝

words.definition: n. 同盟者，盟国；vt. 使结盟（常与 with 或 to 连用）

examples.en: The two countries remained close allies throughout the Cold War.
examples.zh: 整个冷战期间，两国始终是紧密的盟友。

examples.en: The minority party allied itself with environmental groups before the vote.
examples.zh: 投票前，该少数党与环境团体结成了联盟。

words.usage: 动词读 əˈlaɪ，常反身：ally oneself with 或 to sb；名词复数 allies。派生：alliance n. 联盟；allied adj. 联合的，同盟的

confusables.note: 小巷；双写 ll 易混
减轻；双 l 近形词

collocations: a close ally 紧密盟友
ally with sb 与某人结盟
a natural ally 天然的盟友
words.mnemonic: all（同一方）+y → 站在同一边的人 → 盟友

words.definition: n. 家属，亲属；家族

examples.en: The names of the dead were withheld until their next of kin had been notified.
examples.zh: 死者的名字在通知其直系亲属之前暂不公布。

examples.en: Migrants often settle where kin have already established a foothold.
examples.zh: 移民往往定居在亲友已站稳脚跟的地方。

words.usage: 集合名词，无复数；next of kin（最近亲属）为法律用语；kith and kin（亲朋好友）固定习语。派生：kinship n. 亲属关系；kindred n. 亲属
collocations: next of kin 直系亲属
words.mnemonic: kin 谐音「亲」→ 亲属；next of kin 最近亲属

words.definition: vt. 抓住；攫取，抢占；n. 抓，夺

examples.en: He grabbed the falling vase just before it hit the floor.
examples.zh: 他在花瓶落地前一瞬间一把抓住了它。

examples.en: Developers rushed in to grab land along the planned subway line.
examples.zh: 开发商一拥而上，抢夺规划地铁沿线的地块。

words.usage: grab at sth（试图抓住）；grab a bite（随便吃点）、grab sb's attention（吸引注意）口语高频。过去式 grabbed 双写 b。派生：grabber n. 攫取者

confusables.note: 螃蟹；c 与 g 一字差

collocations: grab a bite 随便吃点
grab sb's attention 抓住某人注意力
grab the chance 抓住机会
words.mnemonic: crab（螃蟹）褪去壳 c，伸手 grab 一把抓住

words.definition: vt. 省略，删除；遗漏，疏忽未做

examples.en: Several crucial details were omitted from the published version of the report.
examples.zh: 报告公开版删去了若干关键细节。

examples.en: She omitted to mention that she had already signed with another publisher.
examples.zh: 她没有提及自己已与另一家出版社签约。

words.usage: omit to do 或 omit doing 均可表「未做某事」；被动结构 be omitted from 高频。派生：omission n. 省略，遗漏
collocations: be omitted from... 从…中删去
omit to do sth 忘做某事
words.mnemonic: o（出）+mit（送）→ 把多余的送出去 → 省略

words.definition: adj. 客气的，彬彬有礼的；仁慈的；豪华气派的

examples.en: She was gracious enough to acknowledge her rival's contribution to the project.
examples.zh: 她非常大度，承认了对手对该项目的贡献。

examples.en: The reception was held in the hotel's gracious ballroom.
examples.zh: 招待会在酒店气派的大宴会厅举行。

words.usage: 常指（尤指地位高者）待人谦和有礼；感叹语 Good gracious!（天哪）阅读可见。派生：graciously adv. 有礼地；grace n. 优雅，恩惠
collocations: a gracious host 好客的主人
words.mnemonic: grac（恩惠，同 grace）+ious → 满怀恩惠 → 仁慈有礼

words.definition: adj. 中立的；中性的；n. 中立者，空挡

examples.en: Switzerland remained neutral throughout both world wars.
examples.zh: 两次世界大战期间瑞士始终保持中立。

examples.en: The report adopts a deliberately neutral tone on the merger dispute.
examples.zh: 该报告对并购争端刻意采取中立口吻。

words.usage: remain 或 stay neutral（保持中立）；neutral tone（中性语气）、in neutral（空挡）。派生：neutrality n. 中立；neutralize v. 中和，使无效

confusables.note: 自然的；ne- 与 na- 易串

collocations: a neutral tone 中性语气
words.mnemonic: neuter（两不靠）+al → 哪边都不沾 → 中立的

words.definition: vi. 选择，作出抉择（与 for 或 to do 连用）

examples.en: A growing number of graduates opt for further study rather than immediate employment.
examples.zh: 越来越多毕业生选择继续深造而非直接就业。

examples.en: Users may opt out of the data-sharing scheme at any time.
examples.zh: 用户可随时选择退出数据共享计划。

words.usage: opt for 或 between（在…中挑选）；opt to do（决定做）；opt out of（选择退出）为阅读高频。派生：option n. 选择；optional adj. 可选的

confusables.note: 采取；易与 opt 混拼
恰当的；a 与 o 之差

collocations: opt for sth 选择某物
opt to do sth 决定做某事
words.mnemonic: opt 是 option（选择）的动词核心 → 选择
